description.fr-FR: La première partie du Traité de l’existence de Dieu (la preuve par la nature) dans l’ancienne traduction anglaise anonyme de 1713, sans la division en chapitres de l’original ; l’introduction de H. M. n’est pas reprise.
description.en-US: The first part of the Treatise on the Existence of God (the proof from nature) in the anonymous English translation of 1713, without the chapter division of the original; the introduction by H. M. is not included.
description.pt-BR: A primeira parte do Tratado da existência de Deus (a prova pela natureza) na antiga tradução inglesa anônima de 1713, sem a divisão em capítulos do original.

sources.edition: The Existence of God, anonymous translation of 1713 (CCEL etext, ed. Henry Morley’s Cassell’s National Library)
